name: Label
description: Compact primary-colored label with filled and plain variants and an optional leading icon.

semantics.iconAria: Treat the optional leading icon as decorative.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Decorative 16px icon displayed before the text.

accessibility: Use span semantics because this component represents a visual badge rather than a form label.
Hide decorative icons from assistive technology.
Keep visible text unless the consuming application supplies another accessible name.
adaptationRules: Implement Label as a reusable component in the target application's framework.
Preserve both filled and plain variants.
Use the supplied design tokens for all tokenized values.
Do not install Preact, Sass or any dependency solely for this component.
